tagline: hds#505 soft direction as an overlay: pill actions, soft containers, grey-fill grouping, roomier surfaces. demo-only, not a real client.
_notes: Design-explorations demo tenant (hds#628, phase 0) implementing the token deltas of hds#505. Not a real client: no deployment, no legal entity. Not listed in figma/brand-modes.json; publishing a Brand mode is Adrian's call.

Keeps the base accent (graphite.700, #433A3F), so brand.primaryHex is the default's. It overrides shape, one surface fill and surface padding only; the deltas the tokens cannot express are the README's Gaps.
